description: Schema for daily learning articles linked to roadmap days

fields.role: string, learning role (ai_engineer, data_science_engineer, genai_engineer, ai_automation_engineer)
fields.title: string, article title
fields.content: string, full article text (500-600 words recommended)
fields.reading_score_contribution: integer (0-100), how reading this article affects user score
fields.quiz_reference: object { id, title, questions[] } linking to quiz for this day

requirements.ai_assessment_link: link to practical task / assignment / project assessment popup
